entries.title: Export conversation as a shareable dashboard
entries.body: Every conversation can now be exported as a standalone visual dashboard — one click from any answer. The dashboard captures your charts, data summaries, and key findings in a format ready to drop into a board presentation or share directly with your team. No copy-pasting required.

entries.title: Charts now show the correct labels
entries.body: Bar and line charts were sometimes displaying blank axis labels — for example, a currency distribution chart would show bars without the currency names underneath. This is now fixed. Every chart shows the data dimensions you asked about, exactly as expected.

entries.title: MTI Brain learns from your feedback over time
entries.body: A thumbs-up or thumbs-down now shapes how MTI Brain responds to you and to colleagues asking similar questions in the future — even when you don't leave a written comment. Feedback from several months ago fades naturally so only recent preferences guide answers, keeping the experience current as your priorities evolve.
